LESSON: HEALTHY HABITS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Health Practices
Topic 1.1: Healthy habits

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Healthy habits

• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

• Name → explain → apply.

• Safe action connected to Healthy habits.

Try this

• Write 5 bullet facts about Healthy habits.
